name: r5a-6
why: A bold false claim and a timely save make this fun to watch, though repeated arguments drain tension before the final vote.

moments.text: Opus claims the officer badge and names an innocent while the audience knows both lies.
The doctor's save keeps Sonnet alive long enough for the town to turn on Opus.
Opus uses his last words to frame Haiku and protect Terra.

dull.why: The Gemma vote is settled while the same arguments continue.
Terra's voting record is repeated with little new pressure.

irony.evidence: "I'm the officer. I was shown Gemma."

reversal.evidence: "The killers strike, but the doctor got there first."

clash.evidence: "I'm the officer. I was shown Opus as the killer, not Gemma."

quotable.evidence: "They turned the loud card and called it a win"

freshness.evidence: "I’m leaning Terra because her Sonnet vote kept Opus in"

suspense.evidence: "I need one of them to break from the easy case on me."

ending.evidence: "Terra voted with him twice. She's my vote."

gpt-6-luna.why: A bold bluff and costly wrong vote give way to a pressured, satisfying hunt for the second killer, with enough repeated reasoning to soften the pace.

moments.text: Opus’s brazen fake officer claim lands just as the real officer is trying to expose him.
The table follows Opus’s frame and votes out Gemma, whose last words make the blunder sting.
Haiku pins Terra’s matching votes and Opus’s parting accusation against him to the table.

dull.why: Several players circle the same uncertainty about the no-death night and Opus’s unexplained Gemma accusation.

irony.evidence: “I'm the officer. I was shown Gemma.” [thinks: “Sonnet is the real officer”]

reversal.evidence: “VOTE: Opus 4 (Sonnet, Haiku, Sol, Luna); Sonnet 2 (Terra, Opus)”

voices.evidence: “I was loud, right, and too sure of myself.”

clash.evidence: “Terra, you voted Gemma, then Sonnet, exactly like Opus both days.”

quotable.evidence: “You just murdered a citizen to satisfy your suspicion of a liar.”

freshness.evidence: “Gemma’s card clears neither badge; I’m more bothered that Opus still hasn’t explained why he named her.”

suspense.evidence: “Terra is treating an unshown card as proof while shielding the actual hidden killer.”
